opening.argument: The speaker identifies the papers as a “Notice of Action and Statement of Claim” and describes leaving a copy with the branch manager as service. The accompanying images show a person holding and examining a document, then signing paperwork at a counter inside an RBC branch. Together, these observable details depict a court-related document-service interaction. The described activity is not an investment-return offer, payment demand, or request to collect data, and it does not ask the audience to participate. The material supports an educational or operational demonstration, not a scheme soliciting money or audience action.
